Characters:刘.sentence: 今天小刘很忙。早上他先打开窗户，再拿来一杯水。
Characters:刘.pinyin: Jīntiān Xiǎo Liú hěn máng. Zǎoshang tā xiān dǎkāi chuānghu, zài ná lái yì bēi shuǐ.
Characters:刘.translation: Xiao Liu is busy today. In the morning he opens the window and brings a glass of water.

source.title: Daily Actions & Activities — Part 1: Helping with Everyday Tasks

Characters:朗.sentence: 星期六，两个孩子到公园玩。天气很晴朗，鸟儿在树上唱歌。
Characters:朗.pinyin: Xīngqīliù, liǎng ge háizi dào gōngyuán wán. Tiānqì hěn qínglǎng, niǎor zài shù shang chàng gē.
Characters:朗.translation: On Saturday, two children play in the park. The weather is clear, and birds sing in the trees.

Characters:陈.sentence: 喂，您好！请问陈小姐在吗？
Characters:陈.pinyin: Wèi, nín hǎo! Qǐngwèn Chén xiǎojiě zài ma?
Characters:陈.translation: Hello! Excuse me, is Miss Chen there?
